title: The runtime reaches a host as the cratylus package
situation: The cratylus runtime is already published to the npm registry as the unscoped cratylus package, which provides the cratylus command and depends on the scoped canon, forge and runtime packages; a release on main publishes it, and any ref can be published as a prerelease.
decision: The runtime reaches a host as the cratylus package, installed by the host's package manager, which puts the cratylus command on the host. cratylus install then projects the corpus and the harness adapters, and every adapter calls that installed command. Nothing else places the runtime on a host.
consequences: Capability port's 'delivery places the runtime on every host' is realized by the package; cut 6 builds no other way of placing it, and proves its examples against the package as installed, not against the source workspace. A development machine tries an unreleased build by linking the workspace's cratylus package globally, or by installing a prerelease.
